g.text: Ginkgo v2 · three-phase pattern: Build → Execute → Report · combinatorial SHA-256-deduplicated scenario generation · parallel execution
Discover infra → Generate cluster specs → Deduplicate (SHA-256) → Generate machine specs → Deduplicate
Deduplicated Scenario Map (cluster spec + machine specs per entry)
Suite Setup on Node 1 → Specs distributed across all nodes → Suite Teardown on Node 1
Create (10 min) → health check → smoke tests
Create MD → OSP annotations → wait for node refs
Label nodes → wait for Ready + pod readiness → smoke tests
Update: patch kubelet version → rollout → verify
Per-spec · consumable by any CI system
JSON merge patch after each spec · live progress
Secret: kubeconfig · Job: mounted config + creds
Supporting components: Interactive TUI and Deployment Engine operate orthogonally — TUI drives local runs; Deployment Engine drives in-cluster runs
· Cluster: CNI, proxy mode, expose strategy, … (28 modifiers / 17 groups)
· Machine: CPU, memory, disk, OS distro, image source, DNS policy, eviction strategy, …
